name: Cubbon Park
description: 300-acre heritage park in the heart of the city with walking trails, lawns, statues and the State Central Library.

name: Visvesvaraya Industrial & Technological Museum
description: Interactive science museum with engines, space galleries and hands-on exhibits. Great for kids.

name: Government Museum & Venkatappa Art Gallery
description: One of India's oldest museums — rare antiques, geology gallery and classic Mysore paintings.

name: Karnataka Chitrakala Parishath
description: Premier art college and gallery complex with Raja Ravi Varma paintings and annual art fairs.

name: Indira Gandhi Musical Fountain Park
description: Dancing musical fountain show with coloured lights every evening opposite Vidhana Soudha.

name: Jawaharlal Nehru Planetarium
description: Sky-theatre shows on stars and galaxies, plus a science park with telescope views.

name: Vidhana Soudha
description: Neo-Dravidian seat of the Karnataka legislature — Bengaluru's most iconic building, lit up on Sundays.

name: M. Chinnaswamy Stadium
description: Legendary cricket ground and home of RCB — electric atmosphere on IPL and international match days.

name: St. Mark's Cathedral
description: 1808 colonial-era cathedral with a beautiful baroque dome and serene interiors.

name: Commercial Street
description: Bengaluru's busiest shopping lane — fashion, footwear, jewellery and street food since 1905.

name: Brigade Road
description: Trendy shopping and café strip linking MG Road to Residency Road — the city's classic hangout.

name: Garuda Mall
description: Five-storey shopping and entertainment mall on Magrath Road with food court and multiplex.

name: Ulsoor Lake
description: Sprawling Halasuru lake with boating, a promenade and views of the skyline at sunset.

name: 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar
description: Indiranagar's famous café-and-craft-brewery strip — the city's food and nightlife capital.

name: Bagmane Tech Park
description: Sprawling lakeside IT campus in CV Raman Nagar that anchors east Bengaluru's tech corridor.

name: Phoenix Marketcity
description: One of Bengaluru's largest malls — 300+ stores, PVR, bowling and a buzzing courtyard nightlife.

name: Sri Sathya Sai Baba Temple, Whitefield
description: Revered Shirdi Sai temple with peaceful evening aarti and free annadanam meals.

name: Forum Shantiniketan Mall
description: Whitefield shopping and dining landmark with INOX multiplex next to Pattandur Agrahara metro.

name: International Tech Park Bangalore (ITPL)
description: Iconic ITPL park-and-boulevard in Whitefield — where Bengaluru's IT boom began in the 1990s.

name: Rajarajeshwari Temple
description: Ancient hilltop temple on Mysore Road dedicated to Goddess Rajarajeshwari, by the Vrishabhavathi.

name: Global Village Tech Park
description: Major IT campus off Mysore Road hosting Accenture, Mindtree and other global firms.

name: Freedom Park
description: Former central jail turned 20-acre park with glass-walled jail museum, amphitheatre and protests' ground.

name: Chickpete Shopping Streets
description: 400-year-old wholesale bazaar lanes — silks, saris and electronics at bargain prices.

name: Krishna Rajendra (City) Market
description: Iconic flower-and-produce bazaar — best seen at dawn when jasmine garlands fill the halls.

name: Bangalore Fort (Kempegowda Fort)
description: Remnants of Kempegowda's 1537 mud fort, later rebuilt in stone by Haider Ali and Tipu Sultan.

name: Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace
description: Teak-and-stone Indo-Islamic palace near City Market with a small museum on the Tiger of Mysore.

name: Mantri Square Mall
description: Huge Malleshwaram mall with 250+ brands, food court and PVR — sits right on the metro line.

name: Malleshwaram 8th Cross
description: Heritage market street of flower vendors, old filter-coffee halls and CTR's legendary masala dosa.

name: Orion Mall
description: Lakeside mall at Brigade Gateway with 100+ brands, food court and waterfront evening views.

name: ISKCON Sri Radha Krishna Temple
description: Majestic hilltop temple on Hare Krishna Hill with gold kalash shikhara and evening aarti.

name: Orion Uptown Mall
description: Open-air neighbourhood mall near Jalahalli with fountains, eateries and weekend events.

name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
description: Bengaluru's crown jewel — 240 acres, the 18th-century Glass House and the famous flower shows.

name: Dodda Basavana Gudi (Bull Temple)
description: 16th-century Dravidian temple housing a giant monolithic Nandi bull in Basavanagudi.

name: Jayanagar 4th Block Shopping Complex
description: Classic South Bengaluru shopping block — sweets, silks, keen beans of street food and shopping.

name: Banashankari Amma Temple
description: Popular temple to Goddess Banashankari on Kanakapura Road, busy through the week.

name: Turahalli Mini Forest Viewpoint
description: The city's last mini forest — rocky viewpoint sunrise spot loved by cyclists and boulderers.

name: Ragigudda Prasanna Anjaneya Temple
description: Hilltop Hanuman temple in Jayanagar with a gopuram climb and calm city views.

name: Madiwala Lake
description: Large BTM lake with pelicans, a walking loop and boating near the Madiwala checkpost.

name: Electronic City Tech Park Hub
description: India's iconic IT township — Infosys, Wipro and TCS campuses spread across three phases.

name: Biocon Park, Hebbagodi
description: Biotech giant Biocon's flagship campus anchoring the Anekal-side life-sciences corridor.
